_ghi_chu: Hàng đợi sinh ảnh MVP Vụ 1 trên Topview web (Unlimited/free), 28/09. Kế hoạch: prompts-mvp-vu1-v0.1.md. {BG}/{OBJ}/{DOC} = khối dùng chung bên dưới.
BG: Original clean 2D visual-novel environment illustration of a contemporary Vietnamese university built or renovated between 2015 and 2025; adult scale; bright practical architecture; restrained cel shading; crisp shapes; subtle painted detail; thin or nearly invisible outlines; slightly desaturated background colors; no imitation of a named artist, studio, anime or game. Production-ready 2D visual-novel game background, 16:9 landscape, eye-level camera at 1.65 meters, three-quarter view, clean center and lower foreground left free for two or three character sprites and a dialogue box. Constraints: no people or silhouettes; no readable text or numbers; blank paper shapes only; no logos; no UI; no watermark. Avoid: secondary-school classroom, Japanese school interiors, lockers, cherry blossoms, photorealism, fisheye distortion, excessive clutter, deep black shadows.
OBJ: Single isolated 2D visual-novel prop sprite for a point-and-click hotspot. Style: clean 2D visual-novel illustration matching a bright contemporary Vietnamese university background set, restrained cel shading, thin or nearly invisible outlines, slightly desaturated colors. Camera: eye-level 1.65 meter three-quarter perspective, soft daylight from the upper left. Background: one perfectly flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background filling the whole canvas, no gradient, no texture, no vignette. Framing: 1:1 square, the single prop centered and filling about 70 percent of the frame, fully inside the canvas, nothing cropped. Constraints: no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no glow, no rim light, no outline stroke around the prop, no magenta or pink anywhere on the prop; no readable text (blank or abstract marks only); no logos; no people; no watermark.
DOC: Flat top-down 2D illustration of a single blank paper document for a visual-novel document viewer, filling most of a 3:4 portrait frame, clean restrained cel shading, soft even light, subtle paper texture; all text areas are blank or abstract light gray lines only, no readable text, no numbers, no logos; plain dark neutral gray (#2B2F36) background around the paper; no hands, no people, no watermark.

hang_doi.prompt: {BG} Scene: a modest but well-kept student detective club room: one full-size seminar worktable in the middle distance with six adult stackable chairs; a waist-high filing cabinet whose top surface is left empty; a low open bookcase whose middle shelf is left empty; one older but clean desktop computer with a monitor on a small side desk in the left corner (the club's own computer, not a computer lab); a cork board holding blank paper shapes; broad aluminum windows with red flamboyant foliage outside. Empty spots: middle shelf of the bookcase, top of the filing cabinet, left end of the worktable. Lighting: warm late-afternoon daylight, welcoming and thoughtful. Colors: warm cream walls, honey-brown laminate, faded teal chairs, cool gray tile, small orange architectural accents.

{BG} Scene: a Vietnamese university dormitory room for four male students: two metal bunk beds with checked blankets, a shared study desk with two desk lamps, a small bookshelf, a wall fan, a window with a view of other dorm blocks and trees, a suitcase not yet unpacked beside a bed. Lighting: bright morning sunlight from a window on the left. Colors: pale mint walls, light wood, gray tile floor, blue-gray metal.

{BG} Scene: the entrance gate of a Vietnamese university dormitory complex: a sliding metal gate, a small guard booth with a service window on the right, a wall-mounted notice board next to the gate whose surface is left empty, motorbikes parked neatly under a roof, a row of trees and a five-storey dorm block behind. Empty spots: the notice board surface; the guard booth window counter. Lighting: soft early-morning sun, long gentle light. Colors: cream and pale yellow walls, green trees, gray pavement, dark green gate.

{BG} Scene: the covered forecourt of a Vietnamese university cultural hall prepared for a student club fair: rows of folding tables for club booths with plain tablecloths and small blank standee boards, string pennant flags, a large wall notice board with blank paper shapes, wide steps and columns of the hall behind. Empty spots: the tabletops of the two nearest booths. Lighting: bright sunny morning, festive but calm. Colors: white columns, terracotta roof edge, pastel pennants, gray stone tiles.

{BG} Scene: the ground-floor lobby of teaching building B: a wide staircase on the right with a landing, square columns, a long corridor opening in the background, a wall area on the left next to where a mounted submission box will hang (leave that wall area empty, do not draw any box), a slim bulletin board. Empty spots: the wall section on the left at chest height; the bottom step of the staircase. Lighting: cool clear morning daylight through tall glass doors. Colors: cream-white concrete, cool gray tile, restrained orange beam accents, soft green plants.

{BG} Scene: the academic affairs office of a Vietnamese university: a service counter with a glass partition and one staff desk behind it with a monitor, rows of labeled-but-blank document binders on shelves, a wall notice board whose surface is left empty, a potted plant, a waiting bench. Empty spots: the notice board surface. Lighting: bright neutral office light with daylight through blinds. Colors: white and light gray, pale blue accents, wood-laminate counter.

{BG} Scene: inside a university computer lab: rows of desktop computers on long white desks with black office chairs, one desk in the middle distance left empty with its monitor turned off, an empty floor spot near the back wall where a shared office printer will be placed (do not draw a printer), a whiteboard, vertical blinds. Empty spots: the middle-distance desk; the floor spot by the back wall. Lighting: cool white ceiling panels softened by daylight through blinds. Colors: white, light gray, black chairs, soft blue monitor glow.

{BG} Scene: the indoor corridor outside a university computer lab: a closed lab door with a small glass window and a blank door sign, a long bench, a water dispenser, a blank notice sheet frame on the wall, windows on the opposite side showing trees. Lighting: neutral daytime light. Colors: cream walls, cool gray tile, pale blue door.

{BG} Scene: the student affairs office of a Vietnamese university: a long reception counter whose surface is left empty, a desk document tray on the counter left empty, shelves of binders, a pin board with blank paper shapes, two staff desks with monitors behind, a national-style formal but plain interior without any flags or emblems. Empty spots: the reception counter surface; the document tray; the pin board. Lighting: bright administrative daylight. Colors: white, soft beige, walnut laminate, muted navy chairs.

{BG} Scene: a Vietnamese university student canteen: long tables with stools, a food counter with steel trays and a glass sneeze guard in the background, ceiling fans, open sides with tropical trees outside. Empty spots: the two nearest tables in the middle distance are clear. Lighting: bright noon light, warm and lively but not crowded. Colors: pale yellow walls, stainless steel, green plastic stools, gray tile.

{BG} Scene: a medium-sized review meeting room at a Vietnamese university: long wood-laminate tables arranged so two student groups can face each other, one modest desk for a faculty moderator at the far center, a ceiling projector aimed at a blank screen, vertical blinds, low cabinet with folders. No judge bench, no flags, no emblems. Lighting: cool neutral light softened by daylight through blinds; orderly and serious but humane. Colors: cool blue-gray, pale cream, walnut laminate, black chairs.
